description: This PHP source file defines the 'Restore' controller class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for handling system restore tasks including initiating a restore process and reading backup files to execute SQL commands.

classes.name: Restore
classes.description: Controller class for handling system restore tasks within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the initiation of a restore task by validating input, setting maintenance mode, and scheduling the restore task.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Performs reading and execution of SQL commands from a backup file in chunks, with safeguards against executing disallowed queries, and updates task progress.
